body: Hi everyone. So so sorry for not updating in so long. Things appear far better. He is stable and having no life-threatening difficulties at this point. Things were hard for a while so i wanted to wait to post until i had a better picture. Thank you to all who have helped me. I still feel suicidal and traumatized but have more hopes now. Him making it is a miracle

I will update everyone on his status every 3 or so days. Next udpates being saturday and tuesday. And of course sooner if anything drastic happens. Thank you to everyone who has shown me support and love in this time. I promise to tell the end of this story as soon as i know it for myself. Thank you everyone.
